text:
morgan: Quick UX check — when opening a tool result from the run list the focus flow is confusing. If I Tab through runs, open a result, then Tab, focus jumps to the big "Run again" CTA instead of staying in the panel content.

alex: Repro on Chrome. We programmatically focus the CTA so SRs hear it, but that breaks keyboard users.

jules: Can you paste the repro steps? Is this the slide-over panel not modal?

morgan: Slide-over. Steps: tab to run item -> press Enter to open -> press Tab -> lands on CTA. Closing panel with Esc then Shift+Tab doesn't return focus to the original run item reliably.

sam: Also saw this on Win/Firefox. Keyboard users expect focus to either stay where it was or move to the first meaningful element in the panel. For screen readers, aria-live could announce status instead of stealing focus.

lee: Proposal: on open, focus a logical heading link inside the panel (tabbable) instead of primary CTA. Use aria-live="polite" for the status message like "Tool result opened: validation OK". On close, programmatically return focus to the initiating run control.

alex: I like that. Also add an offscreen "Skip to results" link visible on focus at top of run history for power users.

jules: Copy nit: change button text from "Run again with tools" -> "Re-run". Add an accessible tooltip (aria-describedby) with the longer explanation.

morgan: Accessibility nit: the JSON viewer reads as one big region. Screen reader users can't jump to per-function outputs. Suggest rendering each function result as a collapsible region with role="region" and aria-labelledby so SR users can move between them.

sam: Collapsibles will help skimability. Also ensure chevron contrast 1 is >=4.5:1 across themes; current dark theme value falls to 3.8:1.

lee: I'll update the chevron color on dark theme to #2b2f33 and add visible 2px focus ring on run items.

alex: I'll add a puppeteer test: open panel -> close -> assert activeElement equals original run button. Also update copy and tooltip aria hooks.

jules: Small keyboard flow detail: when panel opens and we focus the header link, Shift+Tab from that header should go back to the run. That preserves predictability. Document this in the pattern lib.

designbot: Checklist reminder: slide-overs must return focus to originating control (pattern lib rule 4.3).

morgan: Thanks. Can we deploy a prototype to sandbox for PM/CS to validate before merge?

alex: Will open PR with accessibility checklist and tests, deploy to sandbox, tag PM/CS for validation. PR link will be posted here when available.

lee: I'll prototype the header-focus variant and the collapsible function sections. Expect PR + screenshots in ~2 days.

morgan: Great, thanks everyone.

designbot: PR reminder: include aria-live usage notes and color contrast adjustments in the changelog.
